high_level_description: This image depicts the snout of the Kolahoi glacier in 2007. The setting is a mountainous area with rugged terrain dominated by rocky surfaces and patches of snow on the higher slopes. The sky is clear and blue, indicating fair weather conditions. The glacier itself appears to be receding, as evidenced by the exposed rock formations at the forefront of the image. The ground is covered with a mix of rocks, gravel, and some small streams of water, suggesting that the melting ice has left behind debris and created channels for runoff.
